title: Research and summarize
prompt: Quick questions before standup: which team has the most open tickets right now, who is on call for that team, and which knowledge base article should we send people who have forgotten their password?

agent_text.text:
I've finished checking all three, so here are the answers.

- **Team with the most open tickets:** Technical Support (TM-002). It has roughly 54 tickets in `open` status. Billing (TM-001) is next with about 44, then Shipping and Logistics (TM-003) with about 42, Account Management (TM-004) with 23 and Escalations (TM-005) with 17. These are my hand-counts from the ticket lists, so treat them as approximate. Technical Support's lead is clear of the others. I counted `open` status only. I didn't include `new` or `pending` tickets.
- **On call for Technical Support:** Noah Rhodes (A-0002). They are a lead, active, and a member of TM-002.
- **Password-reset article:** KB-0001, "How to reset your password". It's published and in the account category. It tells people to choose "Forgot password" on the sign-in page and says the reset link is valid for one hour. It also says to check spam and confirm the address on file if the email doesn't arrive. The last sentence of the body is garbled filler text, so it's worth cleaning up before you send customers there.

Technical Support also has several open "Cannot log in after password reset" tickets. KB-0001 won't help those customers, because their reset link works and they are still rejected.
